reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: syncRoles is an active exported route handler (Gate 1 clear); BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions and the attack path enters via untrusted HTTP request body (Gate 2 clear); src/api/ is explicitly in scope (Gate 3 clear). Spec deviation is real — discord_uid is taken from req.body with no cross-check against the caller's identity, and authMiddleware sets no identity context on req. Attack path requires prior compromise of API_AUTH_TOKEN, making the full exploit chain conditional rather than directly attacker-triggered, hence CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.
